description: This Java class 'TypingExtraDraw' implements the 'ExtraDraw' interface to animate typing text on a canvas, progressively displaying characters over time with customizable paint modifications.

classes.name: TypingExtraDraw
classes.description: A class that handles animated drawing of typing text on a canvas, revealing characters sequentially based on elapsed time.

methods.name: TypingExtraDraw
methods.description: Constructor initializing the typing animation with text, center point, duration per letter, and paint modifier.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs the drawing of the current text state on the canvas, updating the displayed text based on elapsed time.
